Class Lobby

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.lobby.Lobby
public class Lobby extends Object
Aggregate root representing the full mutable state of a single pre-match Lobby.

The Lobby tracks user enrollment, capacity checks, host assignment, and the lifecycle status that gates when the host may start the match; the actual handoff to a game is performed by the controller. It operates using an Observer Pattern (via Listener registration) to notify connected clients of updates, similar to the pattern found in the main Game model.

Domain Rules & Transitions:

  • The lobby capacity must be between MIN_PLAYERS and MAX_PLAYERS.
  • The player who creates the lobby is designated as the initial host (hostNickname).
  • If the host leaves, host authority is automatically re-assigned to the next available player.
  • If all players leave, the lobby status changes to LobbyStatus.CLOSED.
  • The lobby status transitions to LobbyStatus.READY when it is full (i.e. number of players matches capacity). Only in LobbyStatus.READY status can the match be started by the host.

Error Handling Pattern: State-modifying methods are wrapped by executeLobbyAction(Runnable, Listener), which runs the domain logic and catches any IllegalArgumentException/IllegalStateException it throws. On failure it emits an ErrorPayload — unicast to the offending client, or broadcast when no specific target is given — and returns false. On success it only returns true: the success notification (player joined, player left, match started) is sent by the controller, which calls the notify* methods after the action returns.

    • Lobby

      public Lobby(int id, String hostNickname, int capacity)
      Constructs a new Lobby with a specific ID, hosting player, and capacity limit.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique ID of the lobby
      hostNickname - the nickname of the host (first player to join)
      capacity - the maximum player capacity (must be between MIN_PLAYERS and MAX_PLAYERS)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the capacity is out of bounds or nickname is invalid
